[ACT] click 'Add' > fill 'Email': {{email}} > fill 'Password': {{password}} > select 'Sales Rep role': Sales Representative > add {{org}} to Served organizations
[SAVE] click 'Save'
--- ADMIN (action under test) ---
[ACT] select the new rep's row in the grid
[ACT] click 'Delete' in the toolbar
[WAIT] confirmation dialog > confirm delete
--- STOREFRONT ---
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[PRE:SIGNIN_AS:ACME_BUYER]
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/company/sales-reps
[WAIT] table rows loaded
Assertions:
[GRID] (Admin) after Refresh the rep no longer appears on any Sales Reps tab {OBSERVED}
[DOM] (Storefront) no row for AGENT-TEST-SR-Admin-Delete-{{RUN_ID}} appears in ACME_BUYER's Sales Reps table {SPEC}
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] customerSalesReps for ACME_BUYER no longer includes the deleted rep's id
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on the delete request
[CONSOLE] no JS errors on either layer
Failure_Signals: Delete reports success but the row remains after Refresh; the deleted rep still resolves on the storefront buyer list; the delete request 500s
Cleanup: none — the rep was deleted by the test itself; if delete failed, delete it manually via the grid
References: VCST-5304, VCST-5409, DOM-verified vcst-qa (SalesRep 3.1000.0-pr-2-8c40 / Platform 3.1044.0), TLC-2026-07-17-1200

Title: Blocked-Column Icon Reads "Active" for a Blocked Rep (Confirmed — Misleading Label, Not a Functional Defect)
Section: Backend > Sales Rep > Admin > Sales Reps > Grid
Preconditions: Admin logged in as {{ADMIN_EMAIL}}/{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}. SR_REP_BLOCKED is seeded and blocked. DOM-VERIFIED (2026-07-17, SalesRep 3.1000.0-pr-2-8c40): the Blocked column renders an icon whose ACCESSIBLE NAME is "Active" for a blocked rep and "Inactive" for a non-blocked rep — confirmed causally via a throwaway rep observed toggling Inactive→Active on Block, then Active→Inactive on Unblock; the seeded SR_REP_BLOCKED (Blake Barr) independently shows "Active". The icon DOES correctly and reliably flag the blocked state (it flips in sync with Block/Unblock every time) — only the label wording is misleading under a column literally titled "Blocked". Low-severity UX ask (optional, not filed here): consider renaming the icon's accessible label to something block-state-appropriate (e.g. "Blocked"/"Not blocked") instead of "Active"/"Inactive".
Steps:
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/#!/workspace/embedded-app/vc-sales-rep
[ACT] click the 'Sales Reps' tab
[WAIT] grid loaded
[ACT] locate {{blocked_name}}'s row
[ACT] hover/inspect the Blocked column's icon and its accessible name/tooltip for that row
Assertions:
[GRID] {{blocked_name}}'s Blocked column icon has the accessible name "Active" (confirmed causally: this label appears specifically because the rep IS blocked — see Preconditions) {OBSERVED}
[GRID] {{blocked_name}} is nonetheless correctly and reliably flagged as blocked by this icon (a non-blocked rep would show "Inactive" in the same column) — cross-check against SR-EMB-009's tab-level confirmation {OBSERVED}
Cross_Layer_Checks: none
Failure_Signals: the icon's accessible name diverges from the confirmed Active/Inactive mapping for a rep of known block state (would mean the mapping isn't stable); the icon fails to flip when a rep's block state is toggled
Cleanup: none (read-only)
